producer_report.summary: Reworded the t3 trigger so it names only events the cited claims give. It is now "a PR-based worker's ready PR is recorded by the PR-check script, or a local-only worker stops with a clean ready branch", with trigger_evaluated_by "code". t3 now cites c3, c10, c11, c31, c32 and c37. Each of the 11 transitions has a new trigger_actor field (agent, process, person or clock). It is optional in the model schema, as `trigger_actor: Option<Actor>` in athena-cap-study's Transition, because that struct denies unknown fields. In xtask/src/site.rs, `check_trigger_actors` replaces the prefix and keyword test. It runs inside `render`, so the site build fails when it finds a fault. It rejects a missing or unknown trigger_actor, an agent-decided transition whose trigger_actor is not agent, and a cited claim id that is not in claims.json. Tests cover a rejected agent-decided transition with another actor (and one with no actor), an accepted one with agent, an unknown claim, and the real study. The CHANGELOG entry is under Unreleased, Fixed.

open_issues: Two edits went beyond the listed deliverables: crates/athena-cap-study/src/model.rs and rules.rs, for the optional trigger_actor schema field. claims.json was not changed because nothing needed it.
The check is a floor: trigger_actor is a label the study author sets, so it can't stop a trigger text that disagrees with its label.
learnings: athena-cap-study's Transition denies unknown fields and the real model.json is parsed by it in rules tests, so a new model field needs a schema change in model.rs.
xtask's site loads the study as raw JSON values, and its checks live in site.rs.
